_comment: Independent public-input witness for win/tty/topl.c tty_yn_function() lines 444-447 and 451-459 through a [ynq] prompt: a Valkyrie drops her food ration, starts to eat and presses ^P twice at "There is a food ration here; eat it? [ynq] (n)". The first q only redraws the prompt (the doprev arm, with cw->maxcol = cw->maxrow), the second answers it and the object prompt that follows is cancelled. Three ^P at the command level then start from the newest line.
